source_metadata_fields.citation_format: How sources are displayed to users

records.grade_range: Compulsory education; MathBridge primary scope Grades 1-6
records.citation_format: 教育部《义务教育数学课程标准（2022年版）》
records.notes: Primary national authority. The 2022 standard is organised by learning stages rather than giving every requirement as a single-grade prescription. For Grades 1-6, stages are 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6. Exact year-by-year sequencing should therefore be mapped using approved textbook editions and teacher materials in addition to the national standard.

records.citation_format: 人民教育出版社小学数学教材（具体册次）
records.notes: Use edition-specific records before making grade-by-grade claims. Do not treat one PEP edition as the only Chinese classroom sequence.

records.citation_format: Department for Education, National Curriculum in England: Mathematics Programmes of Study
records.notes: Statutory programme of study. Page last updated by DfE in 2021. Year-by-year programmes are published, while schools retain some flexibility within each key stage.
Use specific NCETM resource pages and spine/material identifiers for claim-level citations.

records.citation_format: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics (CCSSM)
records.notes: Reference framework for US mode, not a claim that every US state uses Common Core. State-specific mappings should be stored separately.

records.citation_format: Institute of Education Sciences / What Works Clearinghouse Mathematics Practice Guide
records.notes: Each instructional claim should cite the specific practice guide, recommendation and evidence rating rather than this collection page alone.

records.grade_range: International assessment frameworks, especially Grade 4 and Grade 8
records.notes: Use edition-specific framework records when comparing international expectations.
